prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 79.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.5%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Preset Pet Quick Choice Flow']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Move Sign-In After Pet Selection', 'Interactive Pet Studio Grid', 'Live Generation Progress & Tips', 'Desktop Placement Ping Button', 'Clear Path Time Estimates', 'Desktop Controls Quick Tutorial', 'Stage Layout Custom Pet Studio', 'Account Sync Reassurance Copy', 'Instant Adoption Path Highlights', 'Desktop Ready System Alert', 'Post-Certificate Sign-In Move', 'Desktop Ready System Notification', 'Desktop Controls Spotlight Layout']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Founder Adoption Certificate Badge', 'Split View Photo Upload Preview', 'Starter Pet Toy Reward', 'Custom Photo Quality Guidance Hint']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Choose_path redesign produced the first significant win, but evidence remains thin as only one test of this kind has been run.
No clear effect was seen for adoption redesigns or choose_path copy changes across multiple tests.
Sign-in reordering showed no clear effect in its first test and caused a significant drop in its second test.
Evidence remains thin for finish notifications, finish new screens, finish layouts, home wait info, and sign-in copy changes due to having only one test each.
Predictions were systematically too high across Round 1 tests compared to measured outcomes.
Predictions were too low for the choose_path redesign test, which was predicted to decrease performance (-0.5%) but resulted in a significant win (+6.6%).

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Interactive Persona Path Builder
candidates.change: Rebuild choose_path into a carousel layout showcasing animated preview cards comparing preset companions vs. custom photo-based pets.
candidates.why: Choose_path redesign produced the only major win (+6.6%), and high mean time (514s) indicates users hesitate when picking their setup route.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet's Origin
choose_path.body: Select a ready-to-play companion or create a custom pet from your photos.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Primer Screen
candidates.change: Add an interactive guidance screen right before finishing that demonstrates hotkeys, hiding pets, and desktop interactions.
candidates.why: Support mail highlights post-onboarding confusion around controlling, hiding, or talking to pets (3 emails), while finish conversion sits at 64.8%.

new_controls_primer.headline: How to Interact With Your Desktop Pet
new_controls_primer.body: Learn the basic shortcuts to summon, hide, and interact with your new companion anytime.

components.text: Drag to move • Double-click to talk • Right-click menu to hide

candidates.title: Pre-Configured Pet Trait Flow
candidates.change: Insert a short personality trait picker screen into adoption to let users configure pet temperaments before uploading media or finalizing choice.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and long completion time (mean 1017s), with support emails citing custom pet generation failures.

new_trait_picker.headline: Define Your Pet's Personality
new_trait_picker.body: Choose key traits to tailor how your pet behaves on your desktop.

candidates.title: Account Sync Safety Layout
candidates.change: Reframe sign_in layout to split view with visual badges clarifying that existing pets auto-sync to the signed-in account.
candidates.why: The top support theme is pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails), causing churn during account setup.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe
sign_in.body: Your companion data and customization will automatically sync across devices.
sign_in.hint: Using the same account restores all existing pets instantly.

components.text: Cloud Save Active: No Pet Progress Lost

candidates.title: Desktop Display Diagnostic Hint
candidates.change: Add display hardware compatibility hints and desktop placement tips to the waiting screen while pet assets render.
candidates.why: Support receives tickets about pets not appearing on desktop or app stalling (3 emails), and home waiting phase has a high mean time (2336s).

waiting.hint: If your pet doesn't appear immediately, check system tray overflow or multi-monitor settings.

components.text: Tips: Ensure display scaling is set to standard and overlay permissions are allowed.

candidates.title: Unified Photo Upload Checklist
candidates.change: Transform upload_photos screen into a checklist layout with real-time photo quality validation badges.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is 60.9% and support notes custom pet generation fails or looks wrong (3 emails).

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Provide 1-3 well-lit photos for optimal 3D desktop pet rendering.

photo_upload.text: Front angle photo • Good lighting • Single subject

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Troubleshooting Copy
candidates.change: Revise home_intro headline and copy to clearly state where the pet spawns and how to access desktop tray controls.
candidates.why: Finish conversion is 64.8% with long completion times (mean 5815s), and users report confusion controlling desktop features.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look at the bottom right of your main screen or system tray icon to interact, adjust settings, or manage your pet.

candidates.title: Pet Style Quiz Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a quick 2-question visual style preference screen before choose_path to guide users to their ideal path.
candidates.why: Choose_path takes mean 514s; structural path changes previously yielded a +6.6% win.

new_style_quiz.headline: What Kind of Desktop Companion Do You Want?
new_style_quiz.body: Answer 1 quick question to find your perfect onboarding match.

components.label: Instant Classic Pet vs Custom Photo Rebirth

candidates.title: Background Asset Ready Alert
candidates.change: Enable desktop native completion notifications on the waiting screen when asset generation finishes.
candidates.why: Home phase mean duration is 2336s, showing users leave the app running in background while waiting for generation.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Pet in the Background
waiting.body: You can safely minimize this window. We will notify you when your pet is ready!

candidates.title: Personality Stamp Customizer
candidates.change: Add interactive companion trait badges and customized official stamps to the adoption_certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) and users drop off before reaching the final home delivery steps.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Stamp your certificate and confirm your pet's desktop registration.
